displayName: Abuja Cultural Joints & Street POI Overlay

pois.description: Legendary nocturnal open-flame suya and masa joint opposite Area 1 shopping complex. Hot roasted beef coated in yaji pepper, served with onions and fresh cabbage. Essential energy pitstop for commuters.

culturalPerk.description: Replenishes +35 energy instantly; grants local street intelligence on military checkpoints.

pois.description: The beating heart of Abuja commuter hustle. Dozens of Along drivers shouting 'Along! Along! Wuse! Airport Road!' Agberos collecting ticket levies while fast green-and-white cabs load passengers on the fly.

culturalPerk.description: Reduces Along transit fares by 25%; fastest route connection to Lugbe satellite corridor.

pois.description: The liveliest social artery in West Africa's largest planned housing estate. Lined with Lebanese shawarma spots, rooftop lounges, boutique pharmacies, and neon-lit barbecue joints.

culturalPerk.description: Social capital boost (+20 SC) from networking with middle-class entrepreneurs and tech freelancers.

pois.description: The unofficial foreign exchange capital of Nigeria. Clustered around the Sheraton intersection, mallams with calculator apps and stacks of USD, GBP, and EUR banknotes execute split-second parallel market currency trades.

culturalPerk.description: Unlocks parallel market currency conversion, bypassing banking delays; cash payout multiplier 1.15x for hard currency trades.
